snippet.title: Werewolf on Plato
snippet.description:
Play Werewolf on Plato! It’s the best Mafia-style party game on mobile with super quick & hassle-free gameplay. 

Download (100% for free) on iOS or Android:  https://platoapp.onelink.me/u7Ut/76bfe4c

- 12 unique roles: Werewolf, Alpha Wolf, Vampire, Villager, Doctor, Seer, Hunter, Knight, Princess, King, Necromancer and Jester (with more always being added)

- Auto-moderator and simultaneous turns

- Super fast matchmaking in under a minute

- No ads, power-ups, or other annoyances!

Over 2,000,000 people have made Plato the best place to play, chat and make friends anywhere.
